about: Üki student app and Üki Lock strings for Phase 0. 135 keys come from Figma sheets S.1 (171:15780) and S.2 (172:15868); 87 keys are added by the Phase 0 plan; 3 keys (language.*) are the ҚАЗ, РУС and ENG switch labels from the title bar in Figma; 14 keys were added after the plan for lines the screens need (app.name, lock.name, os.*, lock.pair.device, pair.card.when.*, app.title.offline_unlocked, join.error.* for the other join errors, rules.faq.video.answer, exam.questions.failed), with source added when a frame shows the text and added-not-in-figma otherwise. Kazakh and Russian are first-pass translations; a Kazakh and a Russian speaker read them before Demo Day. Plural messages use ICU syntax. Build with `pnpm i18n:build` into packages/i18n/messages/{en,kk,ru}.json.

keys.en: Sent to {name} by the {office} exam office with Üki. You get this because you are in Group {group}.
keys.kk: Алушы: {name}. Хатты {office} емтихан бөлімі Üki арқылы жіберді. Сіз {group} тобында болғандықтан, бұл хатты алдыңыз.
keys.ru: Получатель: {name}. Письмо отправил экзаменационный отдел {office} через Üki. Вы получили его, потому что состоите в группе {group}.
keys.notes: 0.8 footer. {name} is the student, so an invite redirected to UKI_EMAIL_SINK still says whose it is; {office} is the workspace name; {group} the student's group code. The frame's sender address is left out (decisions). Kazakh and Russian are a first pass: a native speaker must review them (P.18).

keys.en: Sent to {name} by the {office} exam office with Üki. You get this because you are on the exam roster.
keys.kk: Алушы: {name}. Хатты {office} емтихан бөлімі Üki арқылы жіберді. Сіз емтихан тізімінде болғандықтан, бұл хатты алдыңыз.
keys.ru: Получатель: {name}. Письмо отправил экзаменационный отдел {office} через Üki. Вы получили его, потому что внесены в список экзамена.
keys.notes: email.invite.footer_group for a student with no group. Kazakh and Russian are a first pass: a native speaker must review them (P.18).
0.8 "STUDENT ID"; the email shows it in capitals. Same words as join.student_id.label.
0.8 top right: the languages Üki speaks, each in its own language, the same in every email.

keys.en: Exam code {code}. The lobby opens at {lobby}.
keys.notes: Hidden preview line that inboxes show after the subject. {lobby} is a time like 09:40. Kazakh and Russian are a first pass: a native speaker must review them (P.18).

keys.en: Video stays on your laptop. Only events and flagged frames are sent.
keys.kk: Бейне ноутбугыңызда қалады. Тек оқиғалар мен белгіленген кадрлар жіберіледі.
keys.ru: Видео остаётся на вашем ноутбуке. Передаются только события и отмеченные кадры.
keys.notes: 0.8, beside the lock icon. Wording follows rules.video.title and rules.video.body.

keys.en: Run the system check before {weekday, select, mon {Monday} tue {Tuesday} wed {Wednesday} thu {Thursday} fri {Friday} sat {Saturday} sun {Sunday} other {Sunday}}.
keys.kk: Жүйені {weekday, select, mon {дүйсенбі} tue {сейсенбі} wed {сәрсенбі} thu {бейсенбі} fri {жұма} sat {сенбі} sun {жексенбі} other {жексенбі}} күніне дейін тексеріңіз.
keys.ru: Пройдите проверку системы до {weekday, select, mon {понедельника} tue {вторника} wed {среды} thu {четверга} fri {пятницы} sat {субботы} sun {воскресенья} other {воскресенья}}.
keys.notes: 0.8 step 2. {weekday} is the exam day in the workspace time zone (mon to sun); the select keeps each language grammatical. Kazakh and Russian are a first pass: a native speaker must review them (P.18).

keys.en: Install Üki on the laptop you will use.
keys.ru: Установите Üki на ноутбук, с которого будете сдавать экзамен.
keys.notes: 0.8 step 1. Kazakh and Russian are a first pass: a native speaker must review them (P.18).

keys.en: At {lobby}, join with your exam code and student ID.
keys.kk: Сағат {lobby} болғанда емтихан коды мен студенттік ID арқылы кіріңіз.
keys.ru: В {lobby} войдите по коду экзамена и ID студента.
keys.notes: 0.8 step 3. {lobby} is when the lobby opens, like 09:40. Kazakh and Russian are a first pass: a native speaker must review them (P.18).
0.8 subject line. {exam} is the exam title, like "Mathematics 2 · Midterm". Kazakh and Russian are a first pass: a native speaker must review them (P.18).

keys.en: {exam} · {day} {month, select, jan {January} feb {February} mar {March} apr {April} may {May} jun {June} jul {July} aug {August} sep {September} oct {October} nov {November} dec {December} other {December}} · lobby opens {lobby}
keys.kk: {exam} · {day} {month, select, jan {қаңтар} feb {ақпан} mar {наурыз} apr {сәуір} may {мамыр} jun {маусым} jul {шілде} aug {тамыз} sep {қыркүйек} oct {қазан} nov {қараша} dec {желтоқсан} other {желтоқсан}} · кіру уақыты: {lobby}
keys.ru: {exam} · {day} {month, select, jan {января} feb {февраля} mar {марта} apr {апреля} may {мая} jun {июня} jul {июля} aug {августа} sep {сентября} oct {октября} nov {ноября} dec {декабря} other {декабря}} · вход с {lobby}
keys.notes: 0.8 hero, under the title. The date ({day} and {month}, jan to dec, in the workspace time zone) is added to the frame's line, because an invite can come more than a week early (decisions). The month is a select, not Intl: the Edge Runtime has no Kazakh month names. Kazakh and Russian are a first pass: a native speaker must review them (P.18). A no-break space keeps the time (and the day with its month) on one line.
Subject of the test invite from 0.5, sent to the staff member. Kazakh and Russian are a first pass: a native speaker must review them (P.18).

keys.en: Your exam is on {weekday, select, mon {Monday} tue {Tuesday} wed {Wednesday} thu {Thursday} fri {Friday} sat {Saturday} sun {Sunday} other {Sunday}} at {time}.
keys.kk: Емтиханыңыз {weekday, select, mon {дүйсенбі} tue {сейсенбі} wed {сәрсенбі} thu {бейсенбі} fri {жұма} sat {сенбі} sun {жексенбі} other {жексенбі}} күні, сағат {time}.
keys.ru: Ваш экзамен {weekday, select, mon {в понедельник} tue {во вторник} wed {в среду} thu {в четверг} fri {в пятницу} sat {в субботу} sun {в воскресенье} other {в воскресенье}} в {time}.
keys.notes: 0.8 hero title. {weekday} is the exam day in the workspace time zone (mon to sun); the select keeps each language grammatical. {time} is the start, like 10:00. Kazakh and Russian are a first pass: a native speaker must review them (P.18). A no-break space keeps the time (and the day with its month) on one line.
Alt text of the wordmark image in 0.8, for inboxes that block images.
